records.text: Owens identified Taylor Dodd as the former president of the Club America chapter in Bonners Ferry, Idaho, and said he spoke at Charlie Kirk’s vigil when he was 17.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I can tell you now that I already feel vindicated with that warning, because something has already happened involving the president of a Club America chapter in Idaho, or rather, I should say, he's the now former president of Club America in Bonners Ferry, Idaho. ... His name is Taylor Dodd. When he was 17 years old, he actually gave a speech at Charlie Kirk's vigil. ... And, um, he gave testimony regarding his experience having met Charlie (Charlie Kirk) when he was young. Fast forward just one year and, unfortunately for Dodd, just a couple weeks ago he was arrested. And you will never guess for what. Just kidding, you will definitely guess for what. I'm gonna, I'm gonna take it to the chat. What do you guys, what do you guys think?
